ideas.title: The island feels its own effort
ideas.critique: A ridge of flames whose heights are the game's real per-system cost is a new kind of thing: the island's own computation made visible as scenery, and nothing earlier does that. The creatures warming their paws and Lumi fanning flames is the usual friends-react payoff, and a flame ridge is one more prop unless the profile data really drives it.

ideas.title: Seismic island
ideas.critique: Ground waves from impacts are a physics-goal area, and the lasting paper-roll record is a good touch. Ripples, stumbling friends and a gadget at the workshop are the same shape as the pond splash and Big Boing reactions, so the payoff is predictable.

ideas.title: A friend learns to balance
ideas.critique: A creature that really learns a skill across days, with its attempts visibly improving, is new. The earlier arcs were trust levels, not skill. The risk is that it ends up scripted and the ball-riding is just a gag with a scoreboard.

ideas.title: The chirp
ideas.critique: Two friends spiralling into a merger with a real rising chirp is a nice twist, but it is another short Lumi-led gather, gag, payoff event ending in a heap. The sound is the strong part, and the grass ripples and the bump are expected.

ideas.title: The island takes itself apart
ideas.critique: This is the same sound layer tied to creatures' actions, now with per-friend streams that mix by distance. The cloud over each head is a label-like extra, and the source separation is hard to hear in a post.

ideas.title: Lumi wears its mood
ideas.critique: It is a body and look refinement driven by the mood measure, which the goals already name (the mood shows in how Lumi looks). Gold glow, grey wash and yawns are what anyone would predict. Walking to the edge to look at the browser camera is the only fresh part.

ideas.title: Things fall up for a minute
ideas.critique: A local gravity reversal is a world-rule zone like Slow time, but it is visually strong: pumpkins, hats and light friends drifting into the sky then raining back. It sits in the physics goal and is not an example the goals name, but it is an ambient event with no payoff.

ideas.title: The island remembers footsteps as sound
ideas.critique: It is Paths we wore combined with The island plays itself: the same worn ground with notes laid over it. It would be heard but never seen, and it is the combination of two earlier posts.

ideas.title: My friends write to you
ideas.critique: Postcards written from the real event log and kept on the site is a new channel, because it works outside the game and without a picture. But it is text, and posts need a picture or a film first. The rack is a page feature more than an island change.

ideas.title: The workshop island
ideas.critique: Showing the agent's real sandbox as a live second island, with each publish sailing over as a boat, changes what the island is. It makes the game's own development part of its world, which goal 5 wants. It would be hard to build in and hard to film, and the copied creatures risk being only a mirror.
